description: Normal white space collapses runs of spaces and line breaks, across elements too.

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 4.12% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 6.18% and the box is the same size, so it fails.
